slice: RPP-5ld selected AC1027 six-element MLINE retarget tail append
scope: Qualifies a source-bound AC1027 retarget from a six-element MLINE style to another source-bound style after appending one seventh tail element. The selected adapter test checks output field roles, ownership, readback, atomic source-edit refusal, late-mutation refusal and same-adapter retries.

references.use: Groups 71 and 49 encode element count and offsets, repeated 49/62/6 tuples encode each element, and group 70 contains flags. This defines field layout, not consumer regeneration semantics.

Group 340 is the MLINESTYLE object pointer, group 2 is the redundant style name, group 73 stores the element count, groups 74/41 and 75/42 describe per-element segment/fill parameters, and groups 13/23/33 store vertex miter vectors.

contract.admission: Runtime-authored AC1027 source with old and target styles using flags 2, angles 90/90, and six geometry offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0,-2.75,-3.5]. The original tuple colors/LTYPEs are [1,3,4,5,6,7] and [ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer,Continuous]; the target source tuple colors are [5,7,4,5,6,7] with matching LTYPE order. Two source-bound MLINE consumers have three vertices and belong to model space and a named block. The target adds offset -4.5, ACI 4, ByLayer; consumers retarget by group-340 identity with group-2 names preserved.
contract.projection: Require the exact 6-to-7 target tail append, preserving the six offsets as an ordered prefix, flags 2 and angles 90/90. Recompute first group-41 parameters against the target's full minimum (-4.5), preserve source positions/directions/miters and the zero second parameter, and use the target minimum for bottom-justification rebasing (+4.5). The selected adapter geometry routine does not qualify arbitrary MLINE regeneration.
contract.outputAndReadback: For ASCII/binary source and output, prove style tuple order and owner dictionary keys; consumer group 340 and unchanged group 2; group 73=7; exact per-vertex groups 74/75/41 and miter groups 13/23/33; model-space/block ownership; and fresh readback of both styles and both consumers with the expected target and parameters.
contract.failureAndRetry: For each output encoding, a changed existing target offset refuses with destination and caller snapshots preserved; restoring source permits same-adapter retry. A late consumer parameter mutation refuses atomically; restoring caller state permits a fully checked retry. Source-count-six loop cases provide four successful source/output profiles, two source-edit refusals, two late refusals and four retries.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. Source and output drawings are generated at runtime and removed after successful test execution. No DWG/DXF fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: The result qualifies only AC1027 source count 6 to target count 7 by one tail append with the listed tuples, two consumers and unchanged flags/angles. Other source counts, append batches, flags, angles, offsets, carriers, schemas, versions, native CAD behavior, full document closure and broad support claims remain open.

controls.observed: The source-count-six loop has four initial successful output/readbacks, two source-edit rollbacks, two late-mutation rollbacks and four successful same-adapter retries (eight readbacks including retries). Selector totals for source counts 2 through 6 are profiles=20; readbacks=40; refusals=10; late=10; retries=20.
controls.runtimeFixturePolicy: The focused selector authors all inputs and outputs under a temporary directory; it does not commit test drawings.

focusedSuite.summary: All four focused MLINE retarget/append tests passed (4/4); the retarget-append selector covers source counts 2 through 6.
